  WHY: For non-failed blocks, sub(/^[a-z]* /, "") removes the first word (like 'clean ' or 'success '), but leaves any subsequent content on the line. The roster check uses an exact membership test looking for \n<slug>\n in the ledger slugs string. If a non-failed block's slug is followed by other text, the membership check will fail to match the slug, causing the ledger to be reported as not clean even when the reviewer block is present. This blocks auto-merge on the failed-slot path.
